preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N <= 200000 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N and the number of trees K satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i <= 1000000000 for A in test_cases for A_i in A)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each node value A_i satisfies 0 <= A_i <= 1000000000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for N, K, A, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges is exactly N - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= N and 1 <= v_i <= N and u_i != v_i for N, K, A, edges in test_cases for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each edge (u_i, v_i) connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K, A, edges in test_cases) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= 1000000000 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer within the range of possible XOR results.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max_and_of_xor_partitions(N, K, A, edges) for (N, K, A, edges), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum possible value of B_1 & B_2 & ... & B_K for the given tree and K.
